title: Domio CRDT Deck Root Sub-Document
description: Documents the Yjs deck root document shape. The deck root is the parent Y.Doc that owns the SubDocRegistry — a Y.Map of all sub-documents (slides, themes, deck root metadata). It carries the slide RGA order, per-slide sub-doc GUID refs, and the active branch.

subdocs.description: Y.Map('subdocs') — SubDocRegistry mapping semantic keys to sub-document metadata. Each entry stores the Y.Doc GUID and kind (slide, deckRoot, theme).

slideOrder.description: Y.Array('slideOrder') — ordered list of slide semantic IDs (RGA). This is the canonical slide rail that determines presentation order. Concurrent reorders converge via Yjs RGA semantics.

branch.description: Active branch identifier. The deck root doc is branch-aware; each branch may have its own slide order and sub-doc mapping.

SubDocMeta.description: Metadata envelope stored alongside each sub-doc in the parent's SubDocRegistry Y.Map.

docId.description: Y.Doc GUID — the unique identifier for the sub-document.
